booking.title: Multi-tenant booking engine
booking.description: Own the multi-tenant booking engine used across tenants: per-restaurant configurable forms, automated closing rules, room and table assignment with capacity constraints.

api.title: Restaurateur app API
api.description: Rebuilt the restaurateur app API from scratch instead of adapting the old one, redesigning queries, project structure and the API contract.

cache.title: Two-tier cache
cache.description: Designed a two-tier cache (S3 for large nested menu data, DynamoDB for low-latency booking settings) with event-driven invalidation, to take peak-hour reads off the database.

validation.title: Types and validation
validation.description: Introduced a TypeScript type layer and API-boundary validation over deeply nested JSONB configuration that was previously untyped.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure and monitoring
infrastructure.description: Run services on AWS ECS and Kubernetes, with Grafana monitoring and CloudWatch logging.

sentences.first: Restaurant SaaS for thousands of restaurateurs, part of the Zucchetti group.
sentences.second: In-house backend developer on a technical team of eight, and I own the systems behind booking, ordering and promotions.

architecture.title: Full-stack architecture
architecture.description: Designed and built the full-stack architecture of the client-facing portals and the back office.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.description: Built the front end with Next.js, React, Redux Toolkit and Tailwind CSS, from onboarding flows to the user interface.

api.title: REST APIs
api.description: Designed the REST APIs behind them with NestJS and TypeORM, on PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

datawarehouse.title: Data warehouse
datawarehouse.description: Built the company data warehouse: ETL pipelines, data modelling and compliance with sector regulations.

rnd.title: R&D and performance
rnd.description: In R&D, optimised a real-time computation service by moving CPU-bound work onto worker threads, removing event-loop blocking in Node.js.

sentences.first: Italian pioneers of the web3 sector, born as institutional custody of digital assets and later specialised in B2B software for fintech.
sentences.second: I joined during the early build-out of the IT infrastructure and later moved to the R&D division.

other.list: Typescript, Javascript, Jest, AWS, Gitlab, Jira

backend.title: Backend
backend.list: Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Ether.js, Python, pandas
